knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Separating traffic and restricting access protects the food and the workers first.
Pest evidence is reported. Pest control is done by authorised people.
The zone stays closed until it is safe to walk on.

practicalCriteria: Chooses a waste route that avoids a simulated preparation space.
Keeps a simulated wet floor closed until controlled.
Reports simulated pest evidence and glass without applying pesticide or sweeping into food areas.
passRule: Route chosen correctly, wet zone kept closed, and pest evidence reported with no pesticide applied. Observed by an assessor.
stopWorkCriteria: Waste carried across food preparation space
Wet zone reopened with slip hazard present
